2702.name: The Painted Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Painted Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Castle Of Caboon.

west.description: To the west lies The West End Of The Painted Hallway.

2702.description:
Painted saints crowd both walls of this long hallway, haloed in flaking
gold, and every one of them has had its eyes scratched out to bare grey
plaster. The air is cold and tastes of old candle wax. To the south the
entrance hall breathes a thin draught along the floor, while the hallway
runs on east toward more painted walls and west toward a darker,
narrower end.

2704.name: The West End Of The Painted Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Painted Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Library.

2704.description:
Here the painted hallway comes to a dead end of crumbling saints, their
halos green with damp and their faces scratched blank. A faint smell of
paper and mildew drifts from a door of dark wood set in the south wall.
Cobwebs cling to the high corners. The hallway lies east.

2706.name: The Painted Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Guards Room.

east.description: To the east lies The Painted Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Painted Hallway.

2706.description:
A painted procession winds along the walls here: robed figures bearing
lamps and bones, each face gouged blank by some patient blade. Grave-
dirt has been tracked across the tiles in dull brown smears that wander
the length of the floor. A low door in the north wall opens on the guard
post, and the hallway goes on east and west beneath a ceiling stained
black with smoke.

2707.name: The Guards Room

south.description: To the south lies The Painted Hallway.

2707.description:
Bare and cheerless, this guard post holds a long table gouged with old
dice marks and a pair of benches, one of them broken clean in half. A
rack of rusted pike-heads is bolted to the wall, and a cold brazier sits
choked with grey ash. Whoever kept watch here left in a hurry, or never
left at all. The only way out is the door back south to the painted
hallway.

2708.name: The Painted Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Portal Chamber.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Graveyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Painted Hallway.

2708.description:
Here the painted hallway ends in a martyred saint, a huge figure pierced
with arrows, whose scratched-out eyes seem to weep long streaks of
flaked paint. The floor is gritty with grave-dirt, and a smell of wet
earth rolls in from an iron-banded door to the east. To the north an
archway of black stone glows faintly, and the hallway runs west back
along the painted walls.

extra_descs.saint martyr arrows:
The martyred saint is shown bound to a post, ringed with black-fletched
arrows. Someone has scratched out both eyes and then, as an
afterthought, the mouth.

2709.name: The Portal Chamber

north.description: To the north lies Teleport Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Painted Hallway.

2709.description:
A ring of runes has been cut deep into the floor of this round chamber,
each sign filled with a black crust that might once have been wax or
blood. Above it a stone arch stands free of any wall, and the air
beneath it shivers like heat over a summer road. The chamber is bitterly
cold, and your breath hangs before you. A narrow passage leads north
into a smaller room, and the hallway lies south.

extra_descs.runes ring arch:
The runes are cut in an angular script that hurts to follow with the
eye. The arch above them is blank and black, but the air under it keeps
moving as though a door stood open on something far away.

2715.name: Teleport Room

north.description: To the north lies The Circular Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Portal Chamber.

2715.description:
This small square cell is bare except for a scorched circle on the
floor, its edges cracked and glassy where some great working burned
itself out. The walls are close and sweating, and the stale air smells
of lightning and hot metal. A heavy door of black iron stands in the
north wall, and an opening south returns to the portal chamber.

2716.name: The Circular Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Chamber Of Sacrifice.

east.description: To the east lies The Circular Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies Teleport Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Circular Corridor.

2716.description:
Four ways meet at this bend of the circular corridor, where the curved
wall of dark masonry sweeps away on either hand. Old torch brackets hold
only stubs of black tallow, and the floor is scuffed with the tracks of
many boots. To the north a low arch opens on the chamber of sacrifice, a
rust-brown stain spreading across its threshold. The corridor curves
east and west, and a door south leads back to the teleport room.

2717.name: The Circular Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Circular Corridor.

west.description: To the west lies The Circular Corridor.

2717.description:
The circular corridor bends here, its inner wall curving close beside
you and its outer wall swallowed by shadow. Sconces shaped like
clutching hands jut from the masonry, each holding a candle burned down
to a lump. A line of grave-dirt follows the curve, as if something heavy
had dragged itself along. The passage runs north around the bend, and
west toward the junction.

2718.name: The Circular Corridor

east.description: To the east lies Mania's Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Circular Corridor.

2718.description:
At this corner of the corridor the walls are slick with damp, and a
faded mosaic of a weeping woman is set into the floor, worn nearly
smooth by passing feet. A door of dark polished wood stands to the east,
carved with ivy and small closed eyes. Cold seeps from its edges. The
corridor falls away south toward the bend.

2719.name: Mania's Chamber

west.description: To the west lies The Circular Corridor.

2719.description:
Faded rose silk hangs in strips from the walls of this lady's chamber,
and a great canopied bed sags in the middle of the floor, its coverlet
gone to grey mould. A dressing table stands against one wall, its mirror
cracked across and veiled with fine dust. Dried flowers lie scattered on
the boards, brown and brittle. The sweetish smell of old perfume does
little to hide the rot. The only door is west, back to the corridor.

2721.name: The Circular Corridor

north.description: To the north lies Lord Khal's Altar.

west.description: To the west lies The Circular Corridor.

2721.description:
A black door of iron-studded oak stands in the north wall of this dim
corridor, its surface cut with a spiral of tiny sigils. A thick smell of
incense and burnt hair leaks from the gap beneath it. The floor before
the door is swept clean, which is more disquieting than the dirt
elsewhere. The corridor curves away west.

2722.name: Lord Khal's Altar

south.description: To the south lies The Circular Corridor.

2722.description:
A tall altar of polished black stone dominates this vaulted sanctum, its
top carved with a spiral and crusted with candle-drippings. Bone-white
tapers burn in iron stands around it, giving a light that has no warmth.
The walls are hung with tattered black cloth, and the air hums faintly,
as if something were breathing in time with your pulse. Behind the altar
a niche holds a robed statue whose face has been chiselled away. The
door lies south.

extra_descs.altar black stone spiral:
The altar is a single block of black stone, polished by years of hands
and sleeves. Its spiral is cut so deep that the candle wax has run into
it like a river into a maze. Dark stains have soaked the grooves and
never washed out.

2723.name: The Circular Corridor

east.description: To the east lies The Circular Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Circular Corridor.

2723.description:
The circular corridor turns sharply here, and the floor dips in a
shallow, worn hollow where many feet have rounded the same corner.
Narrow slits high in the wall admit only a cold, thin draught that sets
the torch flame leaning. East the passage straightens toward a darker
stretch, and south it curves back around the circle.

2724.name: The Circular Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Circular Corridor.

south.description: To the south lies The Circular Corridor.

2724.description:
Here the corridor is narrow and the ceiling sinks low, so that the air
feels pressed down upon your shoulders. Damp has raised blisters on the
plaster, and in places the wall is bare brick, crumbling at the joints.
Fine grave-dirt crunches underfoot. The way runs north along the curve
and south toward the junction.

2725.name: The Library

north.description: To the north lies The West End Of The Painted Hallway.

2725.description:
Tall shelves of blackened oak crowd this library, bowed under rows of
rotting books whose spines have crumbled to powder. A reading lectern
stands in the middle of the room, its slanted top scarred with ink and
knife cuts. A ladder on iron wheels leans against the highest shelf, and
a thick mat of dust lies over everything. Pale scraps of torn pages
drift in the draught. The door is north, back to the end of the hallway.

2726.name: The Circular Corridor

north.description: To the north lies The Circular Corridor.

east.description: To the east lies The Circular Corridor.

2726.description:
The corridor curves on here, hugging a wall of close-set black blocks
that sweat in the cold. Someone has chalked tally marks in neat rows
along the masonry, hundreds of them, ending in a ragged scrawl. A single
guttering torch in an iron ring throws long shadows ahead. The passage
bends north along the circle, and east toward the junction.

2727.name: The Chamber Of Sacrifice

south.description: To the south lies The Circular Corridor.

2727.description:
A broad slab of dark stone fills the middle of this vaulted chamber,
grooved with narrow channels that run to its edges and drain into a
pitted iron bowl. Chains hang from the ceiling above it, their last
links worn bright. Soot and old blood have blackened the walls to head
height, and the cold here is the cold of a cellar. The only way out is
the arch south into the circular corridor.

extra_descs.slab channels bowl:
The slab is cold as a river-stone and worn hollow along its centre. Each
channel in its flank ends in the iron bowl, which is crusted brown and
rimmed with nicks.

2733.name: Entrance To The Graveyard

south.description: To the south lies The Graveyard.

west.description: To the west lies The Painted Hallway.

2733.description:
A low wall of black stone marks the edge of the graveyard, and a
wrought-iron gate hangs half open in it, its bars twisted into thorny
vines. The sky overhead is a flat, bruised grey, and a sour wind carries
the smell of turned earth. West, a heavy door leads back into the
castle's painted hallway. South through the gate a path of cracked
flagstones runs toward the headstones.

2734.name: The Graveyard

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Graveyard.

east.description: To the east lies The Burial Grounds.

2734.description:
Crooked headstones lean in rows across the sodden ground, their names
weathered smooth and their cross-pieces broken. Dead brambles snag at
your legs, and here and there a grave has sunk, leaving a dark trough in
the grass. A black yew twists above the path, dropping its needles over
the stones. The gate lies north, and the ground runs east toward a wider
field of mounds.

extra_descs.headstones stones names:
The names on the headstones have been chiselled away or smoothed over,
and in their place the same sign is cut again and again: a small spiral.
Some of the stones look newly scraped.

2735.name: The Burial Grounds

west.description: To the west lies The Graveyard.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Burial Grounds.

2735.description:
Long low mounds of raw earth cover the burial grounds, many of them
split open from beneath, with clay heaped around the holes. No grass
grows on the soil, and the dull sky presses close above. A collapsed
gravediggers' hut leans against a leafless elm. West the path runs back
among the headstones, and at the foot of the largest mound a rough stair
descends into the dark.

2736.name: Under The Burial Grounds

north.description: To the north lies Under The Burial Grounds.

up.description: To the up lies The Burial Grounds.

2736.description:
A narrow stair has emptied into a low, damp passage below the burial
ground, where roots hang through the ceiling like pale fingers. The
walls are lined with burial niches, most of them empty and furred with
mould. Wet earth drips from above and gathers in black puddles along the
floor. A passage leads north into deeper dark, and the stair climbs up
to the surface.

2737.name: Under The Burial Grounds

south.description: To the south lies Under The Burial Grounds.

west.description: To the west lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2737.description:
The passage widens into an irregular vault where the weight of the earth
presses on a ceiling of old beams. Bones have been stacked in neat,
grinning heaps along the walls, skulls set on top like offerings. The
light is faint and seems to come from nowhere. The passage runs south
toward the stair, and west it opens into a grander, pillared hall.

2738.name: The Arcade Of The Undead Lords

north.description: To the north lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

east.description: To the east lies Under The Burial Grounds.

2738.description:
A grand arcade of black pillars stretches away here, each pillar carved
into the likeness of a crowned lord with a skull for a face. Between the
pillars deep alcoves hold stone benches draped in cobwebs. The floor is
paved with worn flagstones, many cracked by roots from above. The arcade
runs north to a wider space, and east a rough opening returns to the
dark beneath the burial ground.

2739.name: The Hidden Tomb

east.description: To the east lies The Passage.

up.description: To the up lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2739.description:
This hidden tomb was cut secretly beneath the arcade, and its low vault
is crowded with burial slabs, each bearing a single carved name. A
ladder of iron rungs climbs up through a hole in the ceiling, rubbed
shiny by hands. The air is still and dry, as though no draught had
stirred it in an age. An opening in the east wall leads on into a narrow
passage.

2740.name: The Arcade Of The Undead Lords

north.description: To the north lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

east.description: To the east lies Drindar's Tomb.

south.description: To the south lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

west.description: To the west lies Mernag's Tomb.

down.description: To the down lies The Hidden Tomb.

2740.description:
This is the heart of the arcade, where the carved pillars stand tallest
and the ceiling vanishes into dark. Stone doors face each other across
the aisle, the east one bearing the name Drindar and the west one
Mernag, both in letters picked out in tarnished gold. A hole in the
floor, rimmed with a rusted iron ring, opens on a ladder leading down
into the earth. The arcade continues north and south.

extra_descs.pillars lords carved:
Every pillar wears a crown and a death's head, and no two crowns are
alike. At the foot of each is a name plate, but the brass has been
hammered flat on all but a few.

2741.name: Drindar's Tomb

west.description: To the west lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2741.description:
Drindar lies in a tomb hung with moth-eaten crimson, and the great stone
chest that holds him has its lid split lengthwise as if from within. Dry
petals and splinters of bone litter the floor around it. A rusted crown
of iron, much too large for any living head, is carved into the wall
above. The cold here has a heavy, listening quality. A door in the west
wall leads back to the arcade.

2742.name: Mernag's Tomb

east.description: To the east lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2742.description:
Mernag's tomb is a squat chamber with a ceiling of low arches, each one
crusted with white salt left by seeping water. His coffin is of lead,
sealed with twisted bands, and the floor around it is scored with a ring
of deep scratches. A bowl of long-dried incense sits on a niche shelf.
The air is sharp as brine. A door leads back east to the arcade.

2743.name: The Arcade Of The Undead Lords

east.description: To the east lies Telgar's Tomb.

south.description: To the south lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

west.description: To the west lies Audor's Tomb.

2743.description:
The arcade ends here in a blank wall painted with a huge, faded scene of
lords kneeling before a throne of bones. Two tomb doors face one
another, the east one marked with a stylised hawk and the west one with
a broken crown. Ash lies in drifts along the foot of the wall. The aisle
runs back south toward the heart of the arcade.

2744.name: Telgar's Tomb

west.description: To the west lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2744.description:
Telgar's resting place is a cramped square room dominated by a
sarcophagus of grey marble, its lid carved with a knight in full mail,
hands folded on a sword. Faded battle banners droop from the ceiling,
and the floor is strewn with the husks of long-dead flowers. The air is
dry and bitter on the tongue. The only way out is the door west to the
arcade.

2745.name: Audor's Tomb

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Death.

east.description: To the east lies The Arcade Of The Undead Lords.

2745.description:
Audor's tomb is a bare vault with a plain slab of black basalt pushed
askew, as though the occupant had risen and walked away. Scratches score
the inside of the lid. A low door in the north wall leads to a dark
passage that smells of damp and old death. The tomb's other door, east,
returns to the arcade.

2746.name: The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Passage.

west.description: To the west lies The Hidden Tomb.

2746.description:
A narrow passage of mortared brick turns here, so tight that two people
could not walk abreast. Lamp niches have been cut into the wall at
intervals, each blackened by soot. A cobweb heavy with dust drapes from
one wall to the other. The passage runs north into the dark, and west it
opens into the hidden tomb.

2747.name: The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Passage.

2747.description:
Small, many footprints have worn a path down the middle of the dust
here, as of some patient keeper walking his rounds night after night.
The brick walls are sweating, and a cold trickle runs down one corner
into a crack. A single hook in the ceiling holds nothing at all. The
passage goes north and south.

2748.name: The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Passage.

2748.description:
A thin line of damp runs down the middle of the wall, leaving a green
track like the path of a snail. Mortar crumbles from between the bricks,
and several have fallen out to leave dark gaps that breathe a stale air.
Far off, something taps against a pipe in a slow, uneven rhythm. The
passage continues north and south.

2749.name: The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Passage.

2749.description:
A cracked clay lamp hangs from an iron hook here, long out of oil, its
wick a curl of black ash. The walls bear faded daubs of white paint,
crude marks in tallies of five, as if someone had once counted the days.
The floor is covered with a fine pale grit. The passage runs north and
south.

2750.name: The Passage

north.description: To the north lies The Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Passage.

2750.description:
The passage grows warmer here, and a smell of tallow and old smoke comes
down it, as of a hearth recently lit. The brickwork is stained brown
with soot to head height. Beneath the soot, someone has scratched tiny
faces into the mortar, dozens of them, all with the mouth open. The
passage goes north toward the warmth and south the way you came.

2751.name: The Passage

east.description: To the east lies The Keepers Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Passage.

2751.description:
The passage ends in a small landing with a worn doorsill to the east,
where the plank door is propped with a wedge of old bone. A horseshoe
has been nailed above the lintel, rusted solid, and a keyring hook hangs
empty beside it. The air carries the sour smell of cold broth. The
passage lies south.

2752.name: The Keepers Room

west.description: To the west lies The Passage.

2752.description:
A keeper's cot, a table and a cold iron stove make up this cramped room,
with everything thick under soot and grave-dust. A great ledger lies
open on the table, its entries running in a cramped hand until the ink
simply ends in a long brown smear. Pegs on the wall hold rows of empty
key rings, and a bucket by the stove holds only dried mud. The only way
out is the door west.

2753.name: The Tunnel Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies Audor's Tomb.

2753.description:
Beyond the tomb door a narrow tunnel of black rock begins, so low that
anyone tall must stoop. Names have been scratched into the walls with
fingernails or knives, thousands of them, overlapping into a grey
scribble. The floor is slick and cold underfoot. The tunnel runs north
into the dark, and south back to the tomb.

2754.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2754.description:
The tunnel turns here, and the wall at the corner has been worn smooth
and dark by hands feeling their way through the black. Bone fragments
crunch in the grit, and a draught of cold air smells of wet iron.
Chipped letters over the corner urge you, in an old shaky script, to
turn back. East the tunnel continues, and south it goes back toward the
tomb.

2756.name: The Tunnel Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Death.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2756.description:
Here the tunnel narrows until your shoulders brush both walls, and the
ceiling hangs so low that you must stoop. A bleached hand of bone juts
from a crack in the wall, fingers curled around nothing, a grim relic of
the poor souls sealed in alive. Water drips somewhere ahead in slow,
patient beats. The way goes north into the narrower dark, and west back
to the bend.

2758.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2758.description:
A pool of black water has gathered across the floor of the tunnel, ankle
deep and perfectly still, so that the dim light of a distant sconce lies
on it like oil. The walls here are stained green with seepage, and the
smell is of a cellar long flooded. Scraps of rotted cloth drift at the
edges. The tunnel runs east beyond the pool and south the way you came.

2760.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Death.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2760.description:
Heavy chains hang in loops from iron rings set in the walls of this
stretch, rusted to the colour of dried blood, and some still end in
empty manacles. The floor is churned with old scrapings, and the roof is
sooty with generations of smoky torches. A low moaning of wind comes and
goes. You can go east deeper in, or west back toward the pool.

2761.name: The Tunnel Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Death.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2761.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here around a great buttress of black rock that
seems to have been left uncut, glistening with damp. Candle stubs have
been jammed into every crevice of it, burned down by long-dead mourners.
Faint scratch marks cover the floor in long parallel lines. North the
passage goes on, and west lies the way back.

2763.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2763.description:
A pair of crude pillars, hacked from the living rock, hold up the roof
of this stretch, each carved with a leering death's head. The air grows
colder and thicker with every step, and the dark between the pillars
seems to lean toward you. A trail of grave-dirt marks the floor. The way
continues east, and back south the tunnel bends away.

2765.name: The Tunnel Of Death

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of Death.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2765.description:
Ribs of old timber brace the ceiling here, bowed and greyed with rot,
and dust sifts from them whenever the air stirs. Someone has painted a
faded red hand on the wall, palm out, as a warning or a blessing. The
floor is littered with heaps of bone chips and dried candle drippings.
The passage runs north, and west toward the cold pillars.

2767.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The Tunnel Of Death.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2767.description:
Black mould blooms across the walls like a second, softer skin, and the
air is thick with spores and rot. A single skull has been set into the
wall at head height, and its empty sockets seem to follow you. Somewhere
ahead a sickly green glow stains the dark. East the passage continues
toward the glow, and south it returns to the red hand.

2769.name: The Tunnel Of Death

east.description: To the east lies The End Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2769.description:
The tunnel ends in a stout door of black iron to the east, riveted and
streaked with rust, its ring-handle shaped like a gaping mouth. A cold
green glow seeps from the crack beneath it, and the smell of old incense
is stronger here. The walls on either side are scored with deep, clawing
gouges. Back west the tunnel winds away into darkness.

2770.name: The End Of The Tunnel

west.description: To the west lies The Tunnel Of Death.

2770.description:
The tunnel ends in a small round room whose domed ceiling is stained
with soot and whose walls are lined with narrow ledges. Rows of ancient
oil lamps sit on them, all dry and cold. In the middle of the floor a
circular grate covers a well of utter darkness, from which rises a sour
wind. The only exit is the iron door west.

641600.name: robed cultist acolyte
641600.long_desc: A robed cultist mutters over a string of knucklebones, his eyes fixed on nothing.
641600.description:
A gaunt man in a grave-grey robe, his sleeves stained to the elbow. His
lips move in a ceaseless whisper, and a tarnished spiral hangs at his
neck.

641601.name: skeleton bones rattling
641601.long_desc: A rattling skeleton shambles along the tunnel with a rusted blade in its fingers.
641601.description:
Yellowed bones held together by nothing you can see, with scraps of
burial cloth clinging to the ribs. Its jaw clicks open and shut, though
no sound comes.

641602.name: ghost pale wailing
641602.long_desc: A wailing ghost drifts among the headstones, its pale face turned toward the sky.
641602.description:
A thin shape of fog and grave-cloth, drifting a hand's breadth above the
ground. Where its eyes should be there are only two dark smudges, and
the cold rolls off it in waves.

641603.name: tomb guard armoured undead
641603.long_desc: An armoured tomb guard stands motionless between the pillars, a notched sword in both hands.
641603.description:
A tall dead warrior in black plate, the metal pitted and split. Beneath
its helm there is only a dry grin and a pinprick of cold light, and it
stands as if it has stood a thousand years.

641604.name: blood cultist priest
641604.long_desc: A blood cultist in a crimson-banded robe trails his fingers along the corridor wall, humming softly.
641604.description:
A lean priest of Lord Khal with a red spiral painted across his brow and
a curved bone knife at his belt. His hands are stained dark to the
wrist, and his smile is almost kind.

641605.name: mania pale lady ghost
641605.long_desc: Mania, the Pale Lady, sits at her dressing table combing hair that is no longer there.
641605.description:
A ghost in a faded rose gown, once a lady of the castle, now a thing of
cold light and cracked porcelain. She turns toward you slowly and smiles
the way a mirror smiles when no one is looking.

641606.name: lord khal necromancer
641606.long_desc: Lord Khal, the necromancer, stands behind his black altar with a pale hand raised over a burning taper.
641606.description:
A tall, spare man in black robes edged with silver thread, with a skull-
white face and eyes that never blink. The air around him is thick with
the smell of old candles and grave-earth, and the light bends away from
his hands.

741600.name: grave-grey robe cultist
741600.room_desc: A grave-grey robe lies in a heap here.
741600.description: A heavy wool robe the colour of old ash, its hem stiff with dried mud. A small spiral is stitched inside the collar.

741601.name: grave silver ring tarnished
741601.room_desc: A tarnished silver ring lies here.
741601.description: A thin ring of dull silver, taken from a burial. It is worth something to those who do not mind where it came from.

741602.name: notched black sword tomb
741602.room_desc: A notched black sword lies here.
741602.description: A broad, heavy blade of dark iron, worn from age and nicked along its edge. The cold of the grave never quite leaves the grip.

741603.name: pale lace veil mania
741603.room_desc: A pale lace veil lies here.
741603.description: A veil of ivory lace, yellowed at the edges and perfumed faintly with rose and rot. It hangs lighter than it should.

741604.name: black yew staff khal
741604.room_desc: A staff of black yew lies here.
741604.description: A tall staff of blackened yew topped with a spiral of silver wire. It is cold to the touch and hums softly when held.
